subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A historical photo showed workers building a road.”?
options: Some students looked at it curiously, but no one said anything.
The caption said the project had brought progress to the region.
After a new flood warning project began, teachers brought students to see the marker.
Finally, he stayed after class and said, "My name is Brian."
